title: Quik Facebook Video downloader
summary: Quik - Facebook videos and reels downloader WITHOUT ads
description:
Quik Facebook Video Downloader is a fast and simple way to save Facebook videos on your Android device. Just paste your link, open it in the built-in browser, and tap the download button on the video to start downloading.

Designed for ease of use, the app gives you a clean experience with no ads, straightforward controls, and a dedicated downloads screen where you can track progress, pause or resume downloads, and manage your saved videos

Features
* Download Facebook videos from a built-in browser
* Ad-free experience
* Simple paste-and-open workflow
* Track active and completed downloads in one place
* Pause and resume downloads
* Open, share, or delete saved videos
* Save completed videos to your device gallery for easy access

How it works
1. Paste your Facebook video link
2. Open the page in the in-app Facebook browser
3. Tap the Download Video button shown on the video
4. View progress and manage downloads from the downloads list

Why users will like it
* Fast and straightforward interface
* No complicated setup
* Easy access to saved videos after download
* Handy download management with pause/resume controls

Important notes
* This version currently focuses on Facebook video downloads
* For best results, keep the app open while a download is in progress
* Use this app only for content you own or have permission to save
* This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Facebook
